title: Electrical and Electronics Repairers, Commercial and Industrial Equipment
description: Repair, test, adjust, or install electronic equipment, such as industrial controls, transmitters, and antennas.

tasks.text: Test faulty equipment to diagnose malfunctions, using test equipment or software, and applying knowledge of the functional operation of electronic units and systems.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Electrical testing requires hands-on instrument use

dwas.name: Test electrical equipment or systems to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Maintain equipment logs that record performance problems, repairs, calibrations, or tests.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log maintenance and repair records from data

dwas.name: Maintain repair or maintenance records.

tasks.text: Set up and test industrial equipment to ensure that it functions properly.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Inspect components of industrial equipment for accurate assembly and installation or for defects, such as loose connections or frayed wires.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Locating electrical faults requires hands-on inspection

dwas.name: Inspect equipment to locate or identify electrical problems.

tasks.text: Install repaired equipment in various settings, such as industrial or military establishments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical installation is hands-on licensed trade work

dwas.name: Install electrical components, equipment, or systems.

Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
